proposition: Timeline A.1 places a journey to the Hijaz (queried as 'for pilgrimage?'), in which Ibn Turka invites Sharaf al-Dīn and completes the Sharḥ Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam, in 813/1411; a letter in the Munshaʾāt-i Turka announces a planned departure from Isfahan for the Hijaz and invites Sharaf al-Dīn, but the pages read do not date the letter.
